structuredContent.body:
## Why

The df026 prospective-merge job (PR #153, job 127037102573) passed the complete locked Rust workspace step, then failed strict Clippy at `service_native_v6_ha_read.rs:464`: the final gate closure was unnecessarily passed as `&mut gate` to an `impl FnOnce` parameter. The failure prevented all later CI gates from running.

## Change

Pass `gate` by value at its final use and format the resulting 100-column call chain on one line. The closure still performs the original cold-owner, committed ReadIndex witness, and original-deadline checks in the same order. Earlier mutable uses, the `FinalGate` timing phase, `storage_rejected` mapping, error propagation, and function result remain unchanged. No lint suppression, test removal, budget change, or gate relaxation is added.

This is a one-file successor to `e69e52f28c653d28c5ae36dbbf6eb51b844536bc`; it also carries the preceding Clippy test fixes and dispatch-order test correction from that ancestry. The delta from that parent is one hunk / 14 fewer bytes.

## Validation and limits

- Exact commit: `19ba09ab5c494f25a3531749b0b99fc5c651d56c`; tree: `73ba0c7fdf333b41d3944c5ee58b477026ff2d82`.
- Independently recomputed all 358 Git trees and compared all 3,913 file entries: 3,912 are unchanged and only the reviewed source file differs.
- Strict whole-file forward/reverse reconstruction and an independent source review confirm this is the last closure use, with the original checks preserved.
- Full triggering CI log is retained as blob `356dde085d91e86ed61e97c8924917d5e081eb86` (2,889,750 bytes), with the original failure intact.
- Local Rust/Clippy execution was unavailable. This new immutable head and prospective merge must obtain their own CI results.
- Existing Mac, ROG, X230, and LAN evidence remains attached to its actual df026 source; it is not relabelled as execution of this successor. Full OpenBao 2.7.1 replacement and production cutover remain unqualified.
